# ADR-0104: the figure sheet is carried byte for byte

## Context

A figure declared once must render the same on every surface that carries
the kit. The portal and present sheets had drifted apart in eleven rules,
and no reviewer can hold eleven rules in their head, so review could not
keep them equal. Two attempts to align them by review each failed within a
month.

## Decision

The kit's `figure.css` is carried byte for byte by every product that
carries the kit. A product sheet that differs by one byte fails the drift
check. A product adds figure rules only in a separate sheet loaded after
the kit sheet.

## Consequences

Every product renders a figure the same way, and figure work happens once,
in the kit. A product cannot tune a figure rule locally. A change to the
sheet is a kit release and reaches every product at once. The drift check
runs in every product's CI.

## Alternatives considered

A shared package was rejected: it adds a build step the kit promises not
to need. A per-product override block was rejected: the eleven drifted
rules came from exactly that.

## Architecture impact

None.
